sloka: तदेकवासः संवीता रजोध्वस्ता तथैव च ।शोकसन्तापदीनाङ्गी सीता भर्तृहिते रता ।। ५.५९.२९ ।।।।
transliteration: tadekavāsaḥ saṁvītā rajodhvastā tathaiva ca ।śokasantāpadīnāṅgī sītā bhartṛhite ratā ।। 5.59.29 ।।।।

translations.english: "Wearing the same single cloth which she had worn before, filled with dust, Sita remained sorrowful and piteous wishing her husband's welfare.
